# Contributing Guidelines

Contributions to this package are most welcome!

Please read [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) before reporting anything security related, and
[CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) before taking part.

See the [README](../README.md#building) for how to build the solution, and update
[CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) under **Unreleased** as part of your pull request.
